name: version skew
wording: the version of cratylus that projected a harness's artifacts differing from the version of the cratylus command those artifacts call; reported at every start of the harness, naming both versions and the remedy, install again with the cratylus in use, and never resolved by choosing between builds.
reason: 0077 and 0108: the projected artifacts and the command they call can disagree only when one is replaced without installing again, which is rare and must be visible at once.
